description: This file defines the Converter interface in Java, which specifies methods for converting objects from one type to another. It includes method signatures for checking convertibility, performing conversions, and retrieving source and target classes.

classes.name: Converter
classes.description: A generic interface for converting between different Java object types. Implementations of this interface facilitate type conversions, with methods to check convertibility and perform conversion operations.

methods.name: canConvert
methods.description: Checks whether the converter can convert from sourceClass to targetClass, considering class hierarchies.

methods.name: convert
methods.description: Converts a source object to the specified target type, potentially throwing a ConversionException.

methods.name: convert
methods.description: Converts a source object to the specified target class, using the Class parameter, potentially throwing a ConversionException.

methods.name: getSourceClass
methods.description: Returns the Class object representing the source type for this converter.

methods.name: getTargetClass
methods.description: Returns the Class object representing the target type for this converter.
